payload.core_mechanism_summary: Memoized recursion over (number_of_blocks, remainder) splitting blocks into halves to count concatenations modulo m.
payload.rationale: The solution uses DP with state (b, w) representing number of ways to get remainder w from b blocks. It recursively splits b into two parts and combines remainders with a shift, memoizing results. This is a 2D DP where one dimension is logarithmic due to divide-and-conquer, but still a 2D state DP.
